definitions.explanation: A sudden, violent release of energy, typically with a loud noise and destruction.
A sudden, intense expression of emotion or energy; a rapid increase.

examples.japanese: {爆発|ばくはつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧{爆発|ばくはつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: A gas explosion destroyed the building.

examples.english: When the new song was released, the reaction on social media spread explosively and it became a hot topic overnight.

notes:
USAGE: {爆発|ばくはつ} is used for literal explosions and figuratively for sudden outbursts or rapid increases.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{爆発|ばくはつ}する (to explode)
・{爆発|ばくはつ}を⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to cause an explosion)
・⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}{的|てき}→爆発的：20678_bakuhatsuteki⟧ (explosive)
・⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧が{爆発|ばくはつ}する (emotions explode)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}{物|ぶつ}→爆発物：28282_bakuhatsubutsu⟧ (explosives)

・⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}{的|てき}→爆発的：20678_bakuhatsuteki⟧な⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ (explosive popularity)
・⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧{爆発|ばくはつ} (population explosion)
・⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧{爆発|ばくはつ} (gas explosion)
・⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧{爆発|ばくはつ} (nuclear explosion)
